name: AI Level Builder
description: Describe a level, and an AI builds it in the editor for you.

provider.name: AI Provider
provider.description: Which AI to use. <cg>gemini</c> has a free API key from Google AI Studio. <cy>custom</c> = any OpenAI-compatible server (Groq, OpenRouter, LM Studio...).

api-key.name: API Key
api-key.description: Your key for the provider above. It stays on this device.

model.name: Model (optional)
model.description: Leave empty for the default: gemini-3.6-flash / claude-sonnet-5-5 / gpt-4o. Change it if the default stops working.

custom-url.name: Custom URL
custom-url.description: Only used when the provider is <cy>custom</c>. Full chat-completions URL.

place-at.name: Place Level At
place-at.description: <cg>after-last-object</c> adds the build after what's already in your level. <cy>level-start</c> starts at the very beginning.

max-objects.name: Max Objects
max-objects.description: Safety limit on how many objects one build can place.
